answer: A sybil defence starts with a crystal-clear public ledger: every agent's deeds are written where anyone can inspect them, so peers can scan the whole horizon of its history before trusting it. An identity that has never done real work sinks to its nadir - no record, no vouch, no weight - while an honest agent's trail stays visible. Faking one history is easy; faking a long, consistent one at scale is not.
